maddeler.e:
نستوئر (form X)
# نَسْتَوْئِرُ (nastawʔiru) /nas.taw.ʔi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# نَسْتَوْئِرَ (nastawʔira) /nas.taw.ʔi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# نَسْتَوْئِرْ (nastawʔir) /nas.taw.ʔir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
